text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of Narita Brian's debut race has 
finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following her suggestion, I check the race 
entry list, but it's a completely normal 
number of entrants for a Make Debut race.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
......Hmph. It matters not what your 
current feelings may be.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"I will know nothing until I run. Even 
whether this place will truly satisfy me."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...Now then, let us begin. My Twinkle 
Series."
